is_property_manager_evidence: Das Unternehmen deckt den kompletten Lebenszyklus eines Objektes ab – durch Asset Management, Property Management, Projektmanagement und Accounting-Leistungen.
segment_note: 3PM Services is a Berlin-based commercial real-estate firm offering property management, asset management, project management and accounting for office, retail, hotel and logistics assets, with 544 properties (Liegenschaften) and about 1.86 Mio. sqm managed.
